messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P12345 fired: increased 5xx rate from auth-proxy (eu-west1). Alert rule: inference.gateway.5xx_rate > 4% for 3m. Estimated affected requests: ~12% of traffic to /v1/generate.
oncall-alex: Acked. I'm looking at grafana now. Any known deploys?
sre-jordan: Not aware of any prod deploys in last 30m. I'm seeing a sharp spike in 502/504s originating from auth-proxy upstream timeouts to token-introspect svc.
eng-platform-maya: Adding runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-proxy-5xx|auth-proxy runbook>. Suggest starting with killing unhealthy upstream connections and scaling token-introspect.
oncall-alex: Repro steps from logs: `upstream request timeout after 2s` across many hosts. Backpressure visible on token-introspect pods: CPU at 95%.
product-ops-luis: Customer impact? Any major tenants affected?
customer-success-anna: We're already getting 2 inbound tickets mentioning higher error rates; one enterprise customer in eu-west1 reported 504s. I'll flag them and share status updates.
sre-jordan: I can scale token-introspect replicas in eu-west1 by +4 now. Will also flip to the secondary fallback token cache for short-circuit.
eng-platform-maya: If scaling doesn't reduce latency, we should temporarily route auth traffic to eu-west2. Preparing a routing override.
oncall-alex: Doing quick mitigation: enabling fallback token-cache and increasing token-introspect replicas -> `kubectl scale deploy token-introspect -n infra --replicas=6 -l region=eu-west1`
incident-bot: Action note: oncall-alex performed `scale` at 1746812412.
sre-jordan: Replicas came up, pods are warm, CPU down to ~60%. 5xx rate trending down.
eng-platform-maya: Pushing a conservative rate-limit on incoming token introspect calls at the proxy layer to smooth burst: `rate_limit: 600rps` applied to auth-proxy env.
product-ops-luis: Good to include a customer-facing blurb. Anna, can you draft a short status?
customer-success-anna: Draft: "We're investigating increased 5xx errors affecting authentication in eu-west1. Mitigation in progress; requests are recovering. Will update in 30m."
oncall-alex: Noted decreased error rate to ~1.2% over last 2m. I'll keep monitoring.
sre-jordan: Logging shows a backlog in token-introspect DB queries. Following up with infra to check DB connection pool saturation.
eng-platform-maya: Opening a bridge with infra for DB pool tune. If DB is root cause, plan B is to enable an in-memory cache for short TTLs for token lookups.
product-ops-luis: SLA impact? Any customer-facing escalation needed beyond the blurb?
customer-success-anna: For the enterprise ticket, I'm offering an incident update and ETA ~45m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: P12345 currently acknowledged by oncall-alex, severity: high, escalation policy: inference-prod.
sre-jordan: DB team reports connection exhaustion on a replica — they've increased max connections and are rotating replica. Expecting stabilization in 10-15m.
oncall-alex: Thanks. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. If error rate falls below 0.5% for 15m, we can close.
eng-platform-maya: Postmortem owners: eng-platform (Maya) + SRE (Jordan). We'll collect timelines, deploys, DB metrics.
product-ops-luis: Noted. I'll prepare customer comms once we have stabilization.
customer-success-anna: Sending update to affected customers now.
incident-bot: Closing note: error rate steady at 0.3% for last 6m. Auto-close threshold met. Please confirm before resolving the PagerDuty incident.
oncall-alex: Confirmed stable. I'll resolve P12345 and hand off to postmortem owners.
sre-jordan: Leaving follow-ups: increase DB connection pool defaults, add token-introspect horizontal autoscale policy, and add early-warning alert on DB conn saturation.
eng-platform-maya: I'll file the postmortem and link remediation PRs.
customer-success-anna: Thanks everyone. Customer updates sent.
product-ops-luis: Marking incident as mitigated.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 resolved at 1746812989 by oncall-alex.
